instruction: Please help me install the Pylance extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Pylance extension (ms-python.vscode-pylance) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies installation by checking if 'code --list-extensions' output contains the extension ID. Uses existing is_extension_installed metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Command array format with pipe operator is incorrect - pipe '|' will be treated as literal argument, not shell operator
The command array ["code", "--list-extensions", "|", "grep", "ms-python.vscode-pylance"] will not execute as a shell pipeline
Grep command will not work as intended - should either use shell:true with string command or remove grep entirely
However, the evaluator may still work partially since the metric does substring matching on the output
The semantic intent is correct (verify extension installation) but implementation has a configuration error
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Option 1: Use string command with shell:true - {"command": "code --list-extensions | grep ms-python.vscode-pylance", "shell": true}
Option 2 (Recommended): Simplify to just {"command": ["code", "--list-extensions"]} - the metric already does substring matching, grep is redundant
Option 3: Use shell:true with full command as string - {"command": "code --list-extensions", "shell": false} and rely on metric's contain check
